project_context.description: Legitimate e-commerce for construction materials, designed to pass Google Ads validation.
project_context.target_audience: Contractors, masons, and individuals doing home renovations.

headings.usage: Clean, structured, reliable headers. Do not use generic sans for headings.

body.usage: Highly readable, technical look for product specs and descriptions.

rules: Use #EA580C for primary CTAs like 'Adicionar ao Carrinho' or 'Comprar pelo WhatsApp'.
Maintain high contrast. Never use pure #000000 or #808080.
Footer should use a dark theme (bg-gray-900 text-gray-300) to anchor the site and heavily contrast the main content.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat, solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders (border-gray-200) instead of heavy glassmorphism for product cards. Clinical, organized look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards, shadow-lg for floating elements like the cart drawer.
visual_enhancers.borders: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md max 6px) to match the industrial construction feel.

components.buttons: Rectangular with slight rounded corners (rounded-md). High contrast text. Use robust padding (py-3 px-6). CTA button must be orange-600.
components.inputs: Shadcn default inputs with gray-200 border. Always show clear labels. Focus ring should be orange-500.
components.cards: Cardless or flat with subtle 1px border. No heavy drop shadows. Perfect for product listings.
components.navigation: Sticky white header (bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md) with search bar prominently placed in the center.
components.footer: Massive dark footer. Must include CNPJ, Razão Social, full address (São Luís-MA), phone, email, and explicit links to all legal pages (Privacy, Terms, Shipping, Returns) to pass Google Ads.
components.cart: Slide-in drawer from the right (Shadcn Sheet). Include a mock shipping calculator (CEP) inside the cart.
components.badges: Display security badges (SSL lock icons, 'Compra Segura', Stripe logos) near the checkout buttons and in the footer.

grids.bento_marketing: Use asymmetrical bento grid for the homepage category highlights (e.g., Cimento, Ferramentas, Hidráulica).
grids.product_grid: Dense grid for catalog: grid-cols-2 (mobile) up to grid-cols-4 or 5 (desktop).
grids.admin_dashboard: Tight grid for analytics and tables, utilizing full screen width.

layouts.mobile_first: Mobile checkout must be seamless. Stick add-to-cart bar to the bottom on mobile product pages.
layouts.product_page: Split layout on desktop: sticky product images on left, scrollable info/buy box on right. Display shipping cost calculator explicitly.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing between sections (py-16 to py-24). Tight spacing inside product cards (p-4).

motion.interactions: Hover states on all product cards (subtle -translate-y-1).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform duration-200, transition-colors.
motion.rules: No excessive animations that slow down shopping. Fast, responsive feel.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA against background. White text on Orange CTA is mandatory.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for mobile filters, buttons, and nav links.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

media.icons: lucide-react for all generic icons. react-icons for brand logos (WhatsApp, Stripe).

image_urls.description: Hardware store aisle, useful for the main hero section to establish context.
Stacks of construction materials, good for 'Basic Materials' category card.
Tools laid out, good for 'Tools' category card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React frontend with Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS.
Import 'Outfit' and 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts in your main CSS or HTML file.
Implement the institutional pages required by Google Ads: /sobre, /contato, /politica-de-privacidade, /termos, /trocas-e-devolucoes, /frete.
Footer MUST clearly display: São José Material de Construção, a mock CNPJ (e.g., 00.000.000/0001-00), Full Address in São Luís-MA, Phone/WhatsApp, and Email.
Implement a slide-in Cart drawer (use Shadcn Sheet component).
In the Product Page, add a CEP shipping calculator input and a WhatsApp purchase button alongside standard Add to Cart.
Provide a simple Admin layout (/admin) protected by a mock login to manage products and view orders.
DO NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Add security badges visually (lock icons, 'Pagamento Seguro', Stripe/WhatsApp logos using lucide-react/react-icons).
Adhere strictly to the requested orange/gray/white palette.
Apply `data-testid` to all functional buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
